objections.answer: Subscribe & Save is $49.99 per 28 packs, which is $1.78 a day, and one pack replaces several bottles. Show the maths next to the stack it replaces, and quote Jeremy H. or Rebecca D. Always show the recurring price next to any first-order price.
Pause or cancel anytime, plus a 30-day money-back guarantee on the first order. Kate S. cancelled before her first delivery and then resubscribed, so quote her.

objections.text: "Gummies are just candy / too much sugar"
objections.answer: The Sugar-Free option has <0.5 g sugar and 20 calories per pack. Low Sugar has 8 g added sugar and 50 calories, and we say that plainly. Pectin base, no gelatin, no synthetic dyes. Never call it candy.

A 12-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study in 120 healthy adults found folate +20.5% (2.9x placebo) and vitamin C +40.1% (2.7x placebo) in blood. Claim absorption only, not 'proven to work'.

objections.text: "Is it clean? What about heavy metals?"
objections.answer: Every lot is third-party tested for 70 pesticides, 4 heavy metals, 16 contaminants and 9 microbial contaminants, and it is made in NSF, GMP and FDA-registered facilities. Never say lead-free: the site carries a Prop 65 warning.

objections.text: "Is a handful of gummies really as complete as my greens powder?"
objections.answer: Each pack has 60+ ingredients, 21 vitamins and minerals (100% DV for vitamins, about 25% DV for minerals, on purpose) and 6 g of prebiotic fiber.
Show parent reviews from the Kids page (Tara, Macall, Lianna). It is for ages 2-13, one pack a day, and the smaller Kids pack is 15 g.
